title: Attention Schema Theory (Graziano 2020)

source.title: Consciousness and the attention schema: Why it has to be right
source.version_note: Cognitive Neuropsychology 37(3-4):224-233. Attention schema as schematic control.

passage: Attention schema theory posits that the brain constructs a schematic model of attention (attention schema) to control and predict attention. This schematic model serves as self-model for attention control.
context: Neuroscience domain: attention schema as self-model. Relevant to AI repository's attention/query focus control and schematic model.
source_note: Verified via DOI; attention schema and schematic control confirmed.
literary_invitation: If the repository's query focus is an attention schema, does the schematic control define the 'self' of the repository? How does the schema relate to memory retrieval?
scope_note: Q-003: conditional hypothesis on attention schema (HYP-20261117-b17a54). Excludes phenomenal consciousness claims.
